title: The Book of Enoch (trans. R. H. Charles, SPCK 1917)

verification_log.method: Downloaded the Gutenberg text and read ch. 46

46:1–4: one "who had a head of days", white-haired, with "another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man"; the angel calls him "the Son of Man who hath righteousness", who will raise up kings from their seats

access_notes: Charles dates the Parables (chs. 37–71) c. 105–64 BC; other scholars date them later (Driver, p. 105 n.).
